assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Primary request: Create a polished launch graphic for the GitHub project mlxstab, an experimental command-line video stabilizer for Apple Silicon built with MLX and RAFT. Core idea: "Steady motion. Full frame." It renders at original frame dimensions and outputs a mask of missing-source border pixels; it does not fill those pixels. This artwork must be a conceptual illustration, never a fake result or screenshot.
Art direction: premium editorial design for a technical filmmaking tool. Warm charcoal almost-black (#101310), soft ivory (#F0F0E8), a restrained chartreuse accent (#D6F57B), muted gray-green. Crisp oversized Swiss grotesk typography, small monospaced technical labels, generous negative space, thin hairline rules. No purple, blue gradients, glows, glossy UI, stock device mockups, robot imagery, or visual clutter.
Visual motif: a precise landscape frame, several faint offset/rotated wireframe outlines indicating camera movement, a single firm chartreuse rectangular frame, and fine optical-flow-like curved lines settling into a quiet horizon. A restrained black-and-white mountainous shoreline with fine photographic texture may appear inside the frame, treated as conceptual editorial artwork. Subtle diagonal hatch in a narrow exposed border makes missing coverage legible. No before/after labels, fake metrics, charts, invented commands, endorsements, Apple logos, or generated extra copy.
Typography accuracy: product name is exactly "mlxstab" (m l x s t a b), all lowercase, one word. All text below must appear exactly, with no extra text.
Asset type: GitHub README banner, very wide 8:3 composition, target 2400 x 900 pixels.
Composition: asymmetrical editorial grid with typography in the left 51%, framed cinematic motion illustration in the right 44%; allow 5% outer margins. All elements remain inside the image. Minimal, beautiful at small README width.
Text (verbatim):
"mlxstab" — upper-left brand, compact but very readable
"Steady motion." and "Full frame." — large two-line main headline, ivory
"Video stabilization for Apple Silicon" — restrained subtitle
"MLX / RAFT / METAL" — small footer label
"EXPERIMENTAL" — clear small status label
Do not include a URL.
